Sweet Yogurt | Instant Pot Recipes
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Monday, March 25, 2019 - 8:50am

Ingredients




1/2 gal (2 L) milk
1/4 cup Plain Yogurt, Probiotic with Live and Active Cultures
1 can of sweetened condensed milk

Preparation

1 Add the milk, secure the lid and press “Yogurt” program twice to select “Boil”. 2 When time is up, open the lid, measure temperature. 3 If it doesn’t reach 180 F, cancel “Boil” program.Select (Sauté) program to heat the milk to 180 F quickly. 4 Let the milk cool down to 115F.Add Probiotic Yogurt Culture. Make sure it is a Plain Yogurt with active bacteria. Mix it with the milk. 5 Stir in 1 can of Sweetened Condensed Milk.Secure the lid, press “Yogurt” program and select “Normal Pressure” mode (default), then adjust time to 8 hours. 6 When time is up, a word “Yogt” will appear on the display. Open the Instant Pot.Yogurt looks absolutely gorgeous. It is creamy and very thick. 7 Refrigerate yogurt for a couple of hours or keep in the freezer overnight before serving.

About

 






Prep Time
2H00mins





Cook Time
8H15mins




Total Time
10H15mins





After receiving a positive feedback about Greek Yogurt and Tzatziki, let's continue the dairy topic. This time we are making easy and yummy Sweet Yogurt in Instant Pot! It is a very popular variation of Greek yogurt recipe. As always there is a special magic ingredient that makes our meal particularly soft and delicious. Now it is a can of sweetened condensed milk. Your taste and personal preference are the only criteria that you have to take into account when it comes to sweeten your yogurt. Remember: you can make your Unstrained Yogurt healthier if you just add berries or honey instead of sweet condensed milk.
The best recipes for busy families is the motto of our website. Make delicious and easy Instant Pot recipes with confidence and spirit of adventure.
Video recipe here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uf8ULuHk2Oo
Equipment

Instant Pot DUO80 8 Qt 7-in-1 Multi- Use Programmable Pressure Cooker, Slow Cooker, Rice Cooker, Steamer, Sauté, Yogurt Maker and Warmer
